name: Koukishin ga watashi o korosu
source:
Driven by curiosity, Aito sets out to find the culprit.

One day after school, with the school festival only two days away.

Aito Izumori, a member of the Literature Club, discovers the corpse of a female teacher on the rooftop of the club building.

Aito tries to contact the police, but realizes that the entire club building is a giant locked room.

…Is the culprit still inside this building?

Driven by curiosity, Aito Izumori sets out to find the culprit.

[Translate from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23217]Freem![/url]]
translation:
在好奇心的驱使下，爱瞳动身寻找真凶。

距离学园祭仅剩两天的某个放学后。

文艺部部员伊豆森爱瞳在社团大楼的天台上发现了一名女教师的遗体。

爱瞳试图报警求助，却惊觉整栋社团大楼竟已化作一间巨大的密室。

……凶手难道还躲在这栋楼里吗？

在好奇心的驱使下，伊豆森爱瞳踏上了揪出真凶的调查之旅。
